$comment: Generated by `npm run manifest --workspace @guanxi/ui` (packages/ui/catalog/tooling/manifest.ts). Do not edit.

AppShellChrome.name: actions
AppShellChrome.description: Icon status items and chrome controls at the right of the strip, before the palette button.

AppShellChrome.name: children
AppShellChrome.description: Main, opaque reading surface. It stays mounted while the sidebar changes.

AppShellChrome.name: labels
AppShellChrome.description: Translated product strings supplied by the localized host.

AppShellChrome.name: paletteShortcut
AppShellChrome.description: Keys of the palette shortcut as the platform writes them (for example `['⌘', 'K']`).

AppShellChrome.name: side
AppShellChrome.description: Controlled side. It changes both the visual column order and the DOM/focus order.

AppShellChrome.name: sidebar
AppShellChrome.description:
Host navigation. It should adapt itself to the rail; the chrome does not invent rail content.
A function receives the effective layout: a narrow shell's drawer is never a rail.

AppShellChrome.name: sidebarLabel
AppShellChrome.description: Accessible name for the navigation region and its menu trigger.

AppShellChrome.name: status
AppShellChrome.description: Persistent status items, shown at the left of the strip after the Show button.

AppShellChrome.name: visibility
AppShellChrome.description: Controlled visibility. The sidebar stays mounted when it is hidden.

Badge.name: tone
Badge.description: Colour role; the text itself must carry the meaning.

Button.name: loading
Button.description: Keeps the button focusable, marks it busy and shows a static-under-reduced-motion spinner.

Button.name: loadingLabel
Button.description: Text shown while loading; defaults to the button text.

Button.name: size
Button.description: `md` follows the density control height; `sm` keeps the 24 px minimum target.

Button.name: variant
Button.description: Visual weight. `primary` is the one main action of a surface; `danger` is destructive.

Checkbox.name: label
Checkbox.description: Visible label; the whole row becomes the target. Without it, pass `aria-label`.

Composer.name: describedBy
Composer.description: Id of an element that explains why sending is blocked.

Composer.name: disabled
Composer.description: Disables the whole composer (no node, no session).

Composer.name: header
Composer.description: Above the text area: attachments or chips for non-default options.

Composer.name: label
Composer.description: Accessible name of the text area.

Composer.name: leading
Composer.description: Lower-left controls: the simplified permission mode.

Composer.name: onSend
Composer.description: Called on Enter or Send when sending is allowed.

Composer.name: sendDisabled
Composer.description: Blocks sending but keeps typing; pass the reason so the host can describe it.

Composer.name: textareaRef
Composer.description: The text area element, for hosts that return focus to it (dialogs opened from Send).

Composer.name: trailing
Composer.description: Lower-right controls before Send: model, effort, context.

DialogContent.name: showCloseButton
DialogContent.description: Renders the corner close button; on by default so touch users can always leave.

EmptyState.name: action
EmptyState.description: The one primary action, usually a Button.

EmptyState.name: title
EmptyState.description: One sentence that says what is missing.

ErrorState.name: action
ErrorState.description: The next step the user must take (Open settings). Never Retry: transient failures recover by themselves (D-203).

ErrorState.name: details
ErrorState.description: Copyable technical details; shown in a disclosure.

ErrorState.name: source
ErrorState.description: Machine name of the failing source (mono face).

ErrorState.name: timeMeaning
ErrorState.description: Whether this is the failure time or the time the client observed it.

Icon.name: label
Icon.description: An accessible name. Without it the icon is decorative and hidden from assistive technology.

Icon.name: size
Icon.description: Rendered size in px; the stroke stays 1.75 px at every size.

IconButton.name: badge
IconButton.description: A count (capped at 99+) or `true` for a quiet dot; hidden from assistive technology, so put the fact in `label`.

IconButton.name: icon
IconButton.description: A Lucide icon element; it is hidden from assistive technology.

IconButton.name: label
IconButton.description: Accessible name and tooltip text. Required: an icon alone has no name.

IconButton.name: tooltipOpen
IconButton.description: Controls the tooltip; the catalog uses it to show the open state.

Input.name: invalid
Input.description: Marks the value as invalid (`aria-invalid`); pair it with a visible message.

Kbd.name: keys
Kbd.description: One entry per key; a combination renders as adjacent keys.

MenuItem.name: variant
MenuItem.description: `danger` for a destructive item; it still needs a confirmation that states the effect.

MenuCheckboxItem.name: description
MenuCheckboxItem.description: A quieter second line under the label, e.g. the scope of a setting.

MenuCheckboxItem.name: end
MenuCheckboxItem.description: A trailing value or shortcut before the indicator.

MenuCheckboxItem.name: indicator
MenuCheckboxItem.description: `check` marks a visible item (a shown panel); `switch` draws an inline switch for a setting.

PalettePreview.name: palette
PalettePreview.description: Which generated candidate to show; defaults to the working default.

PopoverContent.name: keepMounted
PopoverContent.description: Keep the content mounted (hidden) while closed, so its children keep their state.

ProvenanceLabel.name: estimated
ProvenanceLabel.description: Guanxi metered or inferred the value.

ProvenanceLabel.name: now
ProvenanceLabel.description: Reference time for the age; defaults to now. Stories pass a fixed time.

ProvenanceLabel.name: observedAt
ProvenanceLabel.description: ISO time of the observation; `null` means the value is unknown.

ProvenanceLabel.name: source
ProvenanceLabel.description: Machine name of the source, shown in the mono face (for example `ollama /api/ps`).

ProvenanceLabel.name: staleAfterSeconds
ProvenanceLabel.description: After this many seconds the label switches to the aged "as of HH:MM" warning.

SegmentedControl.name: iconOnly
SegmentedControl.description: Shows icons only; each label becomes the segment's name and tooltip.

StatusItem.name: badge
StatusItem.description: A count (inbox) or `true` for a quiet dot.

StatusItem.name: children
StatusItem.description: Popover body: facts, provenance and, when needed, one next step.

StatusItem.name: side
StatusItem.description: Where the popover opens; the status strip uses `bottom` and `end` at its right edge.

StatusItem.name: stale
StatusItem.description: The value is the last good sample and the latest read failed: marked and named so.

StatusItem.name: staleLabel
StatusItem.description: Appended to the accessible name while stale, e.g. "last sample 10:30".

StatusItem.name: title
StatusItem.description: Popover heading; defaults to the label.

StatusItem.name: value
StatusItem.description: A short value shown next to the icon ("16.8 GB"); the value carries the weight.

StatusItem.name: wide
StatusItem.description: A wider popover for detail lists (runtime admission and models).

StatusPill.name: label
StatusPill.description: Overrides the default label, for example "Waiting for review".

Switch.name: label
Switch.description: Visible label; the whole row becomes the target. Without it, pass `aria-label`.

Textarea.name: invalid
Textarea.description: Marks the value as invalid (`aria-invalid`); pair it with a visible message.

Toaster.name: limit
Toaster.description: D-136: at most two toasts at once while the app is focused.

Toaster.name: manager
Toaster.description: Shared manager; omit to use the provider's own.

Toaster.name: timeout
Toaster.description: Default auto-dismiss in ms; 0 keeps toasts until dismissed.
